title: Manhattan, KS — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Manhattan is a city in KS with a population of 54,000. The Little Apple with Kansas State University, Fort Riley, and the Flint Hills. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.2.
